Name: Comkiens' Styles Mizu Quail Products
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
[b]Credits to ogs: Mizu for her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]quail mod[/url] and Comkiens for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod[/url].
[/b]
I decided to take a break from my joja mods and updating my current mods to make this texture mod. I been playing with Mizus mods and i like Comkiens style. recently, Cornucopia crops and flowers mods got Comkiens style mods made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Chocoronron/mods?gameId=1303]Chocoronron [/url]and i got the inspiration to make these packs. Hope you guys enjoy them, let me know if there are any bugs. i fix them ASAP, [b]also please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)

[/b]
[b]Also check out my other Comkiens style mods ;)
